verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a transcription API. It documents webhooks, SSE progress, and Zapier/Google Drive integration recipes, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Any versioning in Zapier-based workflows would belong to the host platform, not the product. Because a service that ships automation integrations could plausibly offer this, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes it "none".
